functions.canonical_equivalent: `vicidial-restricted` connector
functions.dependencies: VICIdial private endpoints; command ledger; telephony events
functions.name: middleware-vicidial-adapter
functions.rationale: Preserve restricted telephony capabilities behind OAuth2+mTLS, explicit command prefixes and mandatory read-back.
functions.test_required: VICIdial mock, mTLS, capability denial, idempotency, timeout and unknown-outcome tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: provisioning-service connector orchestrated by Middleware
functions.dependencies: Provisioning service; VICIdial/PJSIP connectors; command ledger
functions.name: middleware-telephony-provisioning
functions.rationale: Provisioning lifecycle/state belongs to provisioning service; Middleware retains tenant/capability authorization and orchestration only.
functions.test_required: Provisioning mock, duplicate desired state, partial failure, rollback and read-back tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: new Asterisk/PJSIP connector to be added
functions.dependencies: Asterisk/PJSIP provider; provisioning service; command ledger
functions.name: middleware-pjsip-adapter
functions.rationale: PJSIP behavior is required but lacks a complete connector manifest in main; it must not remain an ad-hoc entrypoint.
functions.test_required: Asterisk/PJSIP mock, mTLS, tenant, retry, read-back and forbidden-command tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: isolated webphone session connector/API with Keycloak validation
functions.dependencies: Keycloak; provisioning service; telephony session backend
functions.name: middleware-webphone-session-issuer
functions.rationale: Short-lived browser session issuance remains separate from telephony command authority and must not expose provider credentials.
functions.test_required: JWT audience/azp, tenant, expiry, replay, credential non-disclosure and revocation tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: `app.main`, `app.service`, `app.commands`, and connector-runtime API
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; Redis; Keycloak; n8n; Odoo; provisioning; internal integration gateway
functions.name: middleware-integration-api
functions.rationale: This is the principal server API surface. Required endpoint semantics must be inventoried and selectively ported; direct provider writes must become commands/connectors.
functions.test_required: Per-route contract matrix plus authorization, tenant, idempotency and no-direct-write tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: `app.main` intake API plus connector-runtime management API
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; Redis; Keycloak; provisioning service; Odoo boundary
functions.name: middleware
functions.rationale: The container duplicates the integration API and uses legacy route/write boundaries. Preserve only explicitly mapped endpoint behavior behind canonical auth, tenant, inbox/outbox and command controls.
functions.test_required: API contract, JWT/OIDC, tenant isolation, idempotency, capability denial and legacy-route parity tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Odoo connector plus canonical command/result events
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; Odoo connector; Keycloak service identity
functions.name: middleware-odoo-result-worker
functions.rationale: Delivery results remain required, but Odoo writes must pass through the command/capability boundary and record read-back.
functions.test_required: Odoo mock, tenant, duplicate, conflict, retry and read-back completion tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: canonical outbox worker and connector commands
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL outbox; Redis; communications connectors
functions.name: middleware-notification-worker
functions.rationale: Notification scheduling/delivery is required, but every external effect must use an explicit connector and capability.
functions.test_required: Email/SMS mocks, capability denial, retry, receipt and opt-out tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Temporal schedules/workflows and `core/workers-scheduler`
functions.dependencies: Temporal; PostgreSQL; command ledger
functions.name: middleware-scheduler
functions.rationale: Local polling semantics should be represented as durable Temporal schedules or database-backed leases, not an undocumented standalone scheduler.
functions.test_required: Schedule idempotency, missed tick, overlapping lease, restart and delayed callback tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: same canonical API build with staging runtime profile
functions.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL/Redis/Keycloak/n8n
functions.name: middleware-staging
functions.rationale: Staging is an environment of the canonical API, not a separate source history or implementation.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance, staging fail-closed profile and external-effects-disabled acceptance

functions.canonical_equivalent: same canonical notification/outbox worker with staging profile
functions.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL; Redis; mock connectors
functions.name: notification-worker-staging
functions.rationale: Environment-specific deployment only; no separate source implementation should survive.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance and communications mocks with all live effects disabled

functions.canonical_equivalent: same Temporal scheduler/workflow build with staging queue
functions.dependencies: Staging Temporal; PostgreSQL
functions.name: scheduler-staging
functions.rationale: Environment-specific instance of the scheduler replacement.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance, isolated task queue and restart tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: synthetic staging acceptance and release-manifest validators
functions.dependencies: Release manifest; staging API; observability
functions.name: middleware-evidence-runner
functions.rationale: Runtime evidence must come from reproducible acceptance/release tooling, not a permanently running mixed-revision utility container.
functions.test_required: No-effect acceptance, source/digest attestation and evidence immutability tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: capability registry, operation policy and runtime-safety controls
functions.dependencies: Capability registry; Keycloak claims; command policy
functions.name: middleware-policy-engine
functions.rationale: Server policy decisions may contain required behavior, but the new signed capability and activation design remains authoritative.
functions.test_required: Default deny, expiry, tenant mismatch, forbidden prefix and signed activation tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: connector event ingestion plus Temporal workflows
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; provider connectors; event ledger
functions.name: middleware-sync-worker
functions.rationale: The generic sync scope is not explicit enough to port safely. Each synchronized resource must be assigned to a connector/event contract first.
functions.test_required: Resource-specific ownership, tenant, cursor, duplicate and convergence tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: generated n8n workflow packs plus command/event contracts
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; n8n; Keycloak service identity; command ledger
functions.name: middleware-n8n-runtime-worker
functions.rationale: Retain orchestration handoff while making Middleware the authorization and durable-command boundary.
functions.test_required: Signed handoff, scope, idempotency, result correlation and forbidden-direct-write tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Postly connector manifest and n8n workflow pack
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; n8n; Postiz/Postly connector
functions.name: middleware-social-n8n-delivery-worker
functions.rationale: Retain delivery orchestration but move provider calls behind the social connector; do not duplicate Postiz domain logic.
functions.test_required: Social mock, duplicate, provider 429/500, callback and reconciliation tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Temporal reconciliation workflows and command read-back
functions.dependencies: Temporal; PostgreSQL command ledger; connector read-back
functions.name: middleware-reconciliation-worker
functions.rationale: Reconciliation is a core requirement and must compare durable intent with provider read-back before completion.
functions.test_required: Unknown outcome, mismatch, retry, rollback, dead-letter approval and restart tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: provisioning-service connector and tenant-onboarding command boundary
functions.dependencies: Provisioning service; command ledger; telephony connector
functions.name: middleware-extension-allocator
functions.rationale: Resource allocation belongs to provisioning service; Middleware should authorize/orchestrate the command without owning allocation state.
functions.test_required: Idempotent provisioning mock, tenant, desired-state, read-back and duplicate allocation tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: `app.main` signed intake and connector-runtime `webhook_ingress`
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL; Redis; edge ingress; provider signature secrets
functions.name: middleware-event-gateway
functions.rationale: Provider ingress behavior remains required, but verification and acknowledgement must terminate in the canonical durable inbox/outbox.
functions.test_required: Body limit, HMAC, timestamp, duplicate, conflict, tenant routing, restart and redelivery tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: connector-runtime inbox processing plus Temporal/outbox workers
functions.dependencies: PostgreSQL inbox/outbox; n8n control network; connector contracts
functions.name: middleware-external-webhook-worker
functions.rationale: Asynchronous webhook processing is valid only after durable acknowledgement; n8n delivery cannot be the source of write authority.
functions.test_required: Inbox lease, retry, dead-letter, timeout, n8n mock and restart tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Breero connector feeding lead normalization and Odoo connector
functions.dependencies: Breero connector; lead normalization; Odoo connector; PostgreSQL
functions.name: middleware-breero-odoo-worker
functions.rationale: Preserve mapping behavior as two explicit connector boundaries with canonical lead provenance and review policy.
functions.test_required: Breero/Odoo mocks, mapping golden files, consent, suppression, duplicate and tenant tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Postly social connector event ingestion
functions.dependencies: Postly connector; PostgreSQL cursor/inbox; edge/provider API
functions.name: middleware-postly-polling-worker
functions.rationale: Polling may be retained only as connector-owned event acquisition with durable cursors, rate limits and normalized events.
functions.test_required: Cursor restart, rate limit, duplicate event, provider 429/500 and normalization tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: Kyqra/scraper connector, lead normalization, and Odoo connector
functions.dependencies: Scraper/Kyqra connector; lead normalization; Odoo connector
functions.name: middleware-scraper-odoo-delivery-worker
functions.rationale: Scraper discoveries must enter review_pending and cannot write directly to Odoo.
functions.test_required: Review-required, provenance, suppression, no-contact, duplicate and Odoo mock tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: `platform/redis` runtime dependency
functions.dependencies: Staging workers; Redis ACL secret; staging network
functions.name: redis
functions.rationale: Redis remains an optional coordination/cache primitive; durable correctness cannot depend on it.
functions.test_required: ACL, outage, restart, cache-loss and no-durability-dependency tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: same canonical Odoo connector worker with staging profile
functions.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL; Odoo staging/mock; Keycloak
functions.name: odoo-result-worker-staging
functions.rationale: The unique staging revision is release drift, not a distinct supported component.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance and Odoo mock/read-back tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: same scraper→normalization→Odoo connector pipeline with staging profile
functions.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL; scraper mock; Odoo mock
functions.name: scraper-odoo-delivery-worker
functions.rationale: The staging-only image history must collapse into the canonical connector worker build.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance, review_pending and Odoo mock tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: canonical Postly connector delivery worker
functions.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL; Postly mock
functions.name: social-delivery-worker-staging
functions.rationale: Unknown image provenance is unacceptable; behavior must be covered by the canonical social connector.
functions.test_required: Same-image provenance, social mock and no-effect staging tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: canonical dead-letter/replay workflow
functions.dependencies: Temporal; PostgreSQL; Postly connector
functions.name: social-dead-letter-worker-staging
functions.rationale: Use the operator-approved dead-letter replay workflow rather than a social-specific undocumented implementation.
functions.test_required: Approval, audit, correction, replay idempotency and tenant tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: canonical reconciliation workflow plus Postly read-back
functions.dependencies: Temporal; PostgreSQL; Postly connector
functions.name: social-reconciliation-worker-staging
functions.rationale: Social reconciliation is a connector specialization of the shared workflow, not a separate source lineage.
functions.test_required: Postly read-back mismatch, timeout, retry and restart tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: signed connector webhook ingress
functions.dependencies: Staging ingress; connector inbox; n8n staging network
functions.name: callback-staging
functions.rationale: The standalone script and unknown/noncanonical revision should be replaced by the shared signed durable ingress.
functions.test_required: Callback HMAC, timestamp, body limit, duplicate, tenant and durable-ack tests

functions.canonical_equivalent: `platform/postgresql` and canonical migration sets
functions.dependencies: Middleware schemas; connector-runtime schema; staging network
functions.name: postgres
functions.rationale: PostgreSQL remains the durable store; reconcile schemas/migrations rather than porting the container as application code.
functions.test_required: Empty→head, previous→head, downgrade/upgrade, locking, checksum and restart tests

workers.name: scheduler-staging
workers.rationale: Environment-specific instance of the scheduler replacement.
workers.test_required: Same-image provenance, isolated task queue and restart tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: synthetic staging acceptance and release-manifest validators
workers.name: middleware-evidence-runner
workers.rationale: Runtime evidence must come from reproducible acceptance/release tooling, not a permanently running mixed-revision utility container.
workers.test_required: No-effect acceptance, source/digest attestation and evidence immutability tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: capability registry, operation policy and runtime-safety controls
workers.dependencies: Capability registry; Keycloak claims; command policy
workers.name: middleware-policy-engine
workers.rationale: Server policy decisions may contain required behavior, but the new signed capability and activation design remains authoritative.
workers.test_required: Default deny, expiry, tenant mismatch, forbidden prefix and signed activation tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: connector event ingestion plus Temporal workflows
workers.name: middleware-sync-worker
workers.rationale: The generic sync scope is not explicit enough to port safely. Each synchronized resource must be assigned to a connector/event contract first.
workers.test_required: Resource-specific ownership, tenant, cursor, duplicate and convergence tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: generated n8n workflow packs plus command/event contracts
workers.dependencies: PostgreSQL; n8n; Keycloak service identity; command ledger
workers.name: middleware-n8n-runtime-worker
workers.rationale: Retain orchestration handoff while making Middleware the authorization and durable-command boundary.
workers.test_required: Signed handoff, scope, idempotency, result correlation and forbidden-direct-write tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: Postly connector manifest and n8n workflow pack
workers.name: middleware-social-n8n-delivery-worker
workers.rationale: Retain delivery orchestration but move provider calls behind the social connector; do not duplicate Postiz domain logic.
workers.test_required: Social mock, duplicate, provider 429/500, callback and reconciliation tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: Temporal reconciliation workflows and command read-back
workers.dependencies: Temporal; PostgreSQL command ledger; connector read-back
workers.name: middleware-reconciliation-worker
workers.rationale: Reconciliation is a core requirement and must compare durable intent with provider read-back before completion.
workers.test_required: Unknown outcome, mismatch, retry, rollback, dead-letter approval and restart tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: provisioning-service connector and tenant-onboarding command boundary
workers.dependencies: Provisioning service; command ledger; telephony connector
workers.name: middleware-extension-allocator
workers.rationale: Resource allocation belongs to provisioning service; Middleware should authorize/orchestrate the command without owning allocation state.
workers.test_required: Idempotent provisioning mock, tenant, desired-state, read-back and duplicate allocation tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: connector-runtime inbox processing plus Temporal/outbox workers
workers.dependencies: PostgreSQL inbox/outbox; n8n control network; connector contracts
workers.name: middleware-external-webhook-worker
workers.rationale: Asynchronous webhook processing is valid only after durable acknowledgement; n8n delivery cannot be the source of write authority.
workers.test_required: Inbox lease, retry, dead-letter, timeout, n8n mock and restart tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: Breero connector feeding lead normalization and Odoo connector
workers.dependencies: Breero connector; lead normalization; Odoo connector; PostgreSQL
workers.name: middleware-breero-odoo-worker
workers.rationale: Preserve mapping behavior as two explicit connector boundaries with canonical lead provenance and review policy.
workers.test_required: Breero/Odoo mocks, mapping golden files, consent, suppression, duplicate and tenant tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: Postly social connector event ingestion
workers.dependencies: Postly connector; PostgreSQL cursor/inbox; edge/provider API
workers.name: middleware-postly-polling-worker
workers.rationale: Polling may be retained only as connector-owned event acquisition with durable cursors, rate limits and normalized events.
workers.test_required: Cursor restart, rate limit, duplicate event, provider 429/500 and normalization tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: Kyqra/scraper connector, lead normalization, and Odoo connector
workers.dependencies: Scraper/Kyqra connector; lead normalization; Odoo connector
workers.name: middleware-scraper-odoo-delivery-worker
workers.rationale: Scraper discoveries must enter review_pending and cannot write directly to Odoo.
workers.test_required: Review-required, provenance, suppression, no-contact, duplicate and Odoo mock tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: same canonical Odoo connector worker with staging profile
workers.name: odoo-result-worker-staging
workers.rationale: The unique staging revision is release drift, not a distinct supported component.
workers.test_required: Same-image provenance and Odoo mock/read-back tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: same scraper→normalization→Odoo connector pipeline with staging profile
workers.dependencies: Staging PostgreSQL; scraper mock; Odoo mock
workers.name: scraper-odoo-delivery-worker
workers.rationale: The staging-only image history must collapse into the canonical connector worker build.
workers.test_required: Same-image provenance, review_pending and Odoo mock tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: canonical Postly connector delivery worker
workers.name: social-delivery-worker-staging
workers.rationale: Unknown image provenance is unacceptable; behavior must be covered by the canonical social connector.
workers.test_required: Same-image provenance, social mock and no-effect staging tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: canonical dead-letter/replay workflow
workers.name: social-dead-letter-worker-staging
workers.rationale: Use the operator-approved dead-letter replay workflow rather than a social-specific undocumented implementation.
workers.test_required: Approval, audit, correction, replay idempotency and tenant tests

workers.canonical_equivalent: canonical reconciliation workflow plus Postly read-back
workers.name: social-reconciliation-worker-staging
workers.rationale: Social reconciliation is a connector specialization of the shared workflow, not a separate source lineage.
workers.test_required: Postly read-back mismatch, timeout, retry and restart tests
